title: Hunts FH-020S: Staff scan route, nonce table, audited override and held-claim review

source.ref: Split from FH-020 (2026-11-10): the proof core shipped in lib/hunts/staff-proof.ts; the stateful and screen halves need a migration and screens.

detail: Add the single-use nonce table (service role, unique insert backing consumeNonce), the staff scan route and screen, the audited override, the support appeal, and the held-claim review that resumes once after authorized review. Done when: cross-Space staff, replay, expired proof and a paused placement reject through the route, and an authorized review resumes a held claim exactly once. Requires: FH-020, FH-010, FH-019. Owner role: Game systems.
